units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 20:2">Targ. Y. Ex. XX, 2</cite>, sq.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 16:22">Targ. Y. Lev. XVI, 22</cite> <he>רוח ז׳</he>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 4:15">Targ. Job IV, 15</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 28b:5">Ab. Zar. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>ויזדהר מז׳</he> and let him beware of exposing his ear to a draught.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 40b:17">Ber. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>תמרי ז׳</he> dates blown down by the wind.
<cite ref="Nedarim 28b:4">Ned. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>איכא ז׳ נפישא</he> a strong wind is blowing (threatening to mow down the standing crop).
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 3:14">Esth. R. to I, 12</cite> <he>פח ז׳ וכ׳</he> blow a blast into his belly (arouse his anger).

<cite ref="Taanit 24a:16">Taan. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>נשב ז׳</he> (not <he>נשא</he>) a wind arose (gathering clouds); <cite ref="Taanit 25b:15">ib. 25ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 85b:12">B. Mets. 85ᵇ</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 129a:22">Sabb. 129ᵃ</cite> <he>היכא דכריך ז׳</he> in a room where the air is turned around, i.e. in a draught.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 50">Gen. R. s. 50</cite>, beg. (ref. to <he>כמראה הבזק</he>, <cite ref="Ezekiel 1:14">Ez. I, 14</cite>) <he>כרוחא לז׳</he> as the wind drives the sparks at a conflagration; [comment.: as the wind shakes the suspended leather-hose, v. next w.]; <cite ref="Ezekiel 1:14">ib.</cite> <he>כז׳ לעננא</he> as the wind scatters the clouds.
<cite ref="Berakhot 59a:7">Ber. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>כז׳ על פום דני</he> like the rumbling sound produced by blowing into wine vessels; a. fr.
